copy_gaps: The joined readout: §5 L399 (with E12-D02 L80) adds the word 'stale' to the forming bar's readout without a joined string; the tooltip's 'forming' line (§4.7 L330) is drawn 'forming · stale', joined with the ' · ' that separates the tooltip's facts (L328-329); the drawer's title (L343) and L731's announcement would gain the word the same way (for E18-D05's copy deck); neither drawer nor menu is open here.
D7 (L157) also puts 'forming' in the legend, but §4.1's legend line (L218) and §4.9's legend words (L380-382) hold no 'forming' (as board 03 notes): the legend row adds neither 'forming' nor 'stale'.

The chip's announcements: E11-D02 §10 L410 and E17-D01 §7 L218-219 give the regions and timing but no chart sentence for entering T1 or server stale; E17-D01 L218's T2 pattern is the multi-symbol "Price feeds stale 15 s on 4 symbols, including BTCUSDT (open position). New orders off." (not drawn).
The Stale chip's description (the silent topic and the threshold, E11-D02 L410) and SCR-153's state details have no written string here: not drawn (focus is in the plot).

Whether the 15 % dim applies under meta.stale alone is not stated: L399 writes the dim with the T1 chip; E11-D02 L410 dims on the ticker's age; E17-D01 L149 asks for one staleness badge. The server inset draws the chip only.

E17-D01 L124 / L147 draws T2 differently from T1 (the CMP-078 'escalated' header strip "Stale 15 s — new orders blocked on BTCUSDT"); this spec (L399) and E11-D02 (L410) give the chart only the chip's T2 words, so no strip is drawn; the kit's T2 chip is filled in ink with the warning glyph (kit 'chips'). Question for the coordinator (#496 thread): "SCR-030 at ticker T2: does E17-D01 L147's CMP-078 escalated strip 'Stale 15 s — new orders blocked on BTCUSDT' also show (in E12-D02's strip row?), or does E11-D02 L410's chip-only T2 stand?" The inset stays as drawn until the coordinator rules.

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).
'Dims 15 %' (§5 L399) has no token (opacity.muted is 0.7): the stale data ink (digits, candles, marks) is drawn in the dark grey instead of ink; the chip's words carry the state.
An imbalance outline is two rects: a 1.5 px ink frame (§4.4 L282: a token stroke is 1 or 2 px) and an inner rect in the cell's background; the digits draw over both.
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).
A mark beyond the plot (the forming cap 1 px + 2 px above a column whose top is the window's top, an unfinished-auction ledge at the window's edge) is not drawn: §3's 40 rows fill the pane exactly.
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' (3 px) unless the board names another state.
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.
Stale chips: T1 and server stale are outlined pills, the 15 s tier is filled in ink with the warning glyph (kit look; the words carry the tier, E17-D01).

Price labels sit at E11-D02 §5's density gap (40 / 48 / 32 px) on whole-price steps; a label wider than §3's 48 / 56 px gutter floor (L177) extends left into the plot's free margin (memo §3.0: the bar counts are upper bounds).
